This is a Next.js 15 App Router page. Use 'use client' directive. No external dependencies beyond what's already in the dashboard (React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui components from @/components/ui/card, badge, button, progress).

The page must:
1. Display a dark terminal aesthetic with navy/cyan color scheme
2. Auto-refresh every 30 seconds during market hours, 5 minutes after hours
3. Show the Iron Man HUD layout described below
4. Use the existing API at http://localhost:8010

First read the existing dashboard to understand the patterns:

- Read c:\Users\mattm\ThinkorSwim\jarvis-trader\dashboard\app\performance\page.tsx (first 80 lines)

Then write the command center page with this layout:

```
JARVIS TRADER — COMMAND CENTER v2.7
[Header with title, live time, paper mode badge, kill switch button]

Row 1 (4 columns):
- PORTFOLIO: equity, daily P&L, open positions count
- ACTIVE INSTRUMENTS: MCL ✅ WFE=0.82, MNQ ✅ WFE=0.57, MGC 🛑 HALTED
- SAFETY: Kill switch status, daily loss %, drawdown %, consecutive losses
- MARKET SESSION: Current session (pre-market/RTH morning/midday/RTH afternoon/after-hours), VIX level + regime

Row 2 (3 signal cards):
- MCL 1h signal card: current STC estimate, regime, last signal, ATR approx, config
- MNQ 1h signal card: same
- MGC 1d: HALTED card

Row 3 (2 columns):
- Left: Risk gauges (progress bars) — Daily P&L (-X%/-2% limit), Drawdown (-X%/-10%), Consecutive losses (N/7), Margin (15%/40%)
- Right: Recent signals/decisions (last 5 from /decisions/recent) + Pipeline status

Row 4 (2 columns):
- Left: Recent trades table (last 10 from /portfolio/history/trades)  
- Right: Walk-Forward Monitor (hardcoded MCL=0.82, MNQ=0.57 with progress bars + recalc countdown)

Row 5 (3 columns):
- Options Panel: IV proxy (VIX regime), positions count: 0 (options engine built, not yet active)
- Scheduler Status: last scan, next scan, total decisions
- Engine Health: status, uptime, DB status, IB connection
```

API calls to make (use fetch with no-store cache):
- `GET http://localhost:8010/health` → status, kill_switch_active, uptime_seconds, ibkr_connected
- `GET http://localhost:8010/safety/status` → daily_pnl, equity_peak, drawdown_pct, orders_last_minute
- `GET http://localhost:8010/portfolio` → total_equity, daily_pnl, positions
- `GET http://localhost:8010/decisions/recent?limit=5` → recent signals
- `GET http://localhost:8010/scheduler/status` → running, jobs, total_decisions_logged
- `GET http://localhost:8010/macro/snapshot` → vix, vix_regime (may fail if no FRED key — handle gracefully)
- `GET http://localhost:8010/prices/snapshot` → instrument prices

Market session detection (Central Time):
- Before 8:00am: Pre-market prep
- 8:00-9:35am: Pre-RTH (avoid)
- 9:35-11:30am: RTH Morning PRIMARY
- 11:30am-1:00pm: Midday lull
- 1:00-3:30pm: RTH Afternoon SECONDARY
- 3:30-5:00pm: After-hours

Styling requirements:
- Dark background: bg-gray-950 or bg-slate-950
- Card borders: border-cyan-900 or border-slate-700
- Accent colors: text-cyan-400 for labels, text-green-400 for positive, text-red-400 for negative
- Monospace font for numbers: font-mono
- Header: Large title with gradient text
- Active instrument badges: green for APPROVED, red for HALTED
- Kill switch: red button that stands out

Handle all API errors gracefully — show "—" or "Error" for failed fetches, don't crash.

Write the complete React component with TypeScript. Make it production quality.

The page is complete and clean. Here's what was built at `app/command-center/page.tsx`:

**Architecture:**
- `"use client"` directive, no new dependencies — only `useSWR`, `lucide-react`, and the existing `@/components/ui/*` + `@/lib/api`
- All API calls go through the existing `/api/engine` proxy (→ `http://localhost:8010`), using the `fetchEngine` helper for consistent error handling

**5-Row Iron Man HUD Layout:**

| Row | Content |
|-----|---------|
| **Header** | Gradient title, live 1-second clock, PAPER MODE badge, engine online/offline badge, red KILL SWITCH button |
| **Row 1** (4 cols) | Portfolio equity/P&L/positions, Active Instruments with WFE badges, Safety Layer (kill switch + 4 risk metrics), Market Session (VIX + regime) |
| **Row 2** (3 cols) | MCL/MNQ signal cards (WFE, regime, last signal, ATR), MGC HALTED card with centered X icon |
| **Row 3** (2 cols) | Risk Gauges (4 progress bars: daily P&L, drawdown, consecutive losses, orders/min), Recent Signals feed + pipeline status |
| **Row 4** (2 cols) | Recent Trades table (10 rows from `/portfolio/history/trades`), Walk-Forward Monitor (WFE bars + recalc metadata) |
| **Row 5** (3 cols) | Options Engine panel (inactive, VIX proxy), Scheduler Status (jobs list), Engine Health (IBKR, DB, uptime, refresh button) |

**Smart features:**
- Market session detection in Central Time with DST awareness
- Auto-refresh: **30s** during RTH/afternoon, **5 min** after-hours/weekends
- All failed API fetches show `—` gracefully — no crashes
- Kill switch animates with `animate-pulse` when active
- Correct color semantics: `text-green-400` profit, `text-red-400` loss, `text-cyan-400` labels
